audit.whatIsWrong: phases[0..6].side is the flat "Skill" placeholder on every row while content win[0..3]=Lulu and win[4..6]=Janna, and the full-layer why text is generic filler unrelated to either side.
audit.why: Content whys are grounded (Lulu's double-bolt Glitterlance out-ranges Janna's single Q pre-6; Monsoon flips it at 6 against her single-target Wild Growth). packet.levelChart agrees.

audit.why: Spikes already correctly state Lulu's early poke-war win and Janna's level-6/late teamfight flip via Monsoon vs. single-target Wild Growth.

audit.why: enemyAbilities.E confirms the real name is "Help, Pix!".
